result.topic_en: Calculation of the second solution of the hypergeometric equation near x=0 in the logarithmic (degenerate) case where the exponent difference is an integer m, giving series with Gamma (Π) functions, digamma (Ψ) terms and log x.

methods.what: Expression of the hypergeometric function at 1-x as combination of two power series at x=0 via Gamma functions
Reflection formula for Gamma function applied to shifted arguments
Limit by differentiation with respect to parameter (L'Hôpital) in integer exponent-difference case, yielding digamma and log terms
